question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>U</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mover><mi>V</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mover><mi>i</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>-</mo><mover><mi>j</mi><mo>^</mo></mover></math> and <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>W</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>3</mn><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>i</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>5</mn><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>j</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>+</mo><mn>3</mn><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>k</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>.</mo></math> If <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>n</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover></math> is a unit vector such that <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mover><mi>U</mi><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>⋅</mo><mover><mi>n</mi><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> and  <math><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>V</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>⋅</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>n</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math>, then <math><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>W</mi></mrow><mo>→</mo></mover><mo>⋅</mo><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>n</mi></mrow><mo>^</mo></mover></mrow></mfenced></math> is equal to

solution.text:
∵ n^ is perpendicular to both U→ and V→
Hence, n^=λU→×V→
n^=±λ-2k^
Since n^ is unit vector hence n^=1
⇒2λ=1
⇒λ=12
Hence, n^=±k^
So, W→⋅n^=3
